title: The Case of the Ship That Never Sank
slogan: AI NEWS · HUMAN-CENTRED · HUMANS IN CONTROL
music: Elegiac cello and piano, no vocals.
ambience: Soft cinema lobby murmur fading into gentle sea wind, no music.

sources.name: Encyclopedia Titanica (Joseph Dawson; survival by class)

shots.say: Case eight, part two. Nineteen ninety-seven. A love story on a sinking ship becomes one of the most watched films in history.

ov.text: THE SIR JACK FILES · CASE 08 · PART 2

sfx.prompt: Old film projector whirring and clicking in a cinema, soft audience murmur

shots.say: Titanic took in more than two billion dollars and won eleven Oscars. For twelve years, no film earned more.

sfx.prompt: Warm applause in a large theatre hall

shots.say: Was Jack real? No. Jack and Rose were invented. But in Halifax, a grave marked J. Dawson belongs to Joseph Dawson, a coal trimmer who died that night. Fans still visit. The director says the name was a coincidence.

ov.sub: Joseph Dawson: real, 23, a coal trimmer

sfx.prompt: Light snow and soft wind in a quiet cemetery, distant seagulls

shots.say: Here is the secret. The film turned a statistic into faces. About sixty-two percent of first-class passengers survived. In third class, about one in four.

sfx.prompt: Faint string quartet playing a gentle waltz in a grand hall, heard from far below deck

shots.say: In twenty twenty-two, deep-sea robots took about seven hundred thousand images of the wreck and built a full digital twin. Technology lets us see the ship. A story lets us feel it.

sfx.prompt: Deep sea sonar pings with submarine hum, underwater ambience

shots.say: Even now, new Titanic videos, some made with AI, find millions of viewers. Because Titanic never sank from memory. Not because of the ship, but because of the people on it. Case closed.

sfx.prompt: Gentle sea waves at dawn on a ship deck, seagulls far away, hopeful
Single heavy rubber stamp thud on paper on a wooden desk
